name: print-social-story-gadget-deal-red-gift-confetti
title: Red gadget mega-deal story with gift bag and confetti
whatItIs: A vertical story-format promo on a red radial-gradient background, showing product renders spilling from a red gift bag with gold confetti and a bold gold-gradient headline.
whatItMeans: Using a radial red gradient centers attention directly on the products while the falling confetti motif ties this story to the matching square-post version of the same campaign.
techniques: use a radial gradient centered on the hero product to naturally draw the eye inward
show products 'spilling out' of a bag/container for a gift-reveal narrative
match confetti and gold-gradient treatments across format variants (story vs. square) for campaign cohesion

vocabulary.definition: a gradient that transitions outward from a central point in concentric rings, rather than in a straight line
